qualitySale.heroSubtitle: Committed to your satisfaction beyond project completion
qualitySale.heroBody: We believe exceptional interior design extends well beyond project completion. Varsovia offers reliable after-sales support, maintenance guidance, and prompt assistance — keeping your interiors looking and performing at their best for years to come.
qualitySale.step1Desc: Schedule a visit with our after-sales team at your convenience.
qualitySale.step2Desc: Our specialists inspect the issue and assess the best course of action.
qualitySale.step3Desc: We carry out repairs, adjustments, or deep cleaning as needed.
qualitySale.step4Desc: Final quality check ensures your space is restored to perfect condition.
qualitySale.faq1Q: Is my project covered under warranty?
qualitySale.faq1A: Yes — Varsovia Design provides warranty coverage on materials and workmanship. Specific terms depend on your project scope and will be shared in your project agreement.
qualitySale.faq2Q: How can I request after-sales support?
qualitySale.faq2A: Reach us through the contact page, email, or phone. Our team will log your request and schedule a visit at the earliest convenience.
qualitySale.faq3A: We offer scheduled maintenance and check-ups for modular kitchens, wardrobes, and fitted furniture to keep everything in top condition.
qualitySale.faq4Q: What happens if my warranty period has expired?
qualitySale.faq4A: We still provide full support — our team can assist with paid service visits, spare parts, and upgrade recommendations.
